standard_prerequisites.name: Dominating modifications by admissible blowups
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms of Spaces, lemma dominate-modification-by-blowup (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a U-admissible blowup X' -> X dominating Y -> X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Principalization of supported ideals
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the defining ideal of the blowup into an invertible one by a point-blowup sequence.

standard_prerequisites.name: Universal property of blowing up
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors on Spaces, lemma universal-property-blowing-up (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Factors the original morphism through the final blowup once the ideal is inverted.

core_obligations: Apply the domination lemma to get a U-admissible blowup X' -> X dominating Y -> X; replace Y by this blowup so that Y is the blowing up of X in an ideal sheaf I supported on T.
Apply the principalization lemma to get a sequence X_n -> ... -> X_0 = X of blowups in closed points over T with I O_{X_n} invertible.
By the universal property of blowing up, the identity map on the complement and the trivialization give the desired factorization X_n -> Y -> X.
proof_roadmap: Admissible blowup domination; principalization of the supporting ideal; factorization via the universal property.
difficulty_reason: A three-step construction chain; the substantive logic is recognizing Y as a blowup after domination and then un-doing it by the principalization sequence.
